name: プロフェッショナルランキング
original_name: プロフェッショナルランキング
overview:
To mark our first ever regular broadcast, we’re unveiling the TOP 20 of the 【TBS Drama Tear-Jerking Theme Song Ranking】, as decided by a serious vote from 133 music professionals!

back number, Uru, Mr.Children, Koji Tamaki, B'z, Kenshi Yonezu, Aimyon, MISIA… We bring you the theme songs and iconic scenes from dramas that are sure to have moved you to tears! Which song will be crowned the number one ‘most tear-jerking theme song’?!
